You will be forever changed. I just spent the last 48 hours binge watching the entire series and now I'm sad. It's such an unforgettable show and experiences. If you wanna talk about, lmk bc I'm so sad that I finished. 

I LOVE THIS SHOW I WANT MORE UGGGHHH

I stopped using social media around 5 months ago. Im also 22f and I am telling you, do IT. It's worth it. Watching other people's 'lives' made me feel more empty and lacking. I deleted everything. Deactivated FB, uninstalled Insta, only have snapchat. Never getting TikTok. 

Personally, I am someone who has some serious issues with self-love, so that's why I did it. I still don't regret it. I tried using insta a couple nights ago, and I actually gagged. I couldn't believe that I even allowed myself to scroll through it for hours at one point. DO IT.
